storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Fantasy Story
storyTemplate.description: A clean fantasy-adventure start: leave home, reach a walled city, and register at the Adventurer's Guild.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The road from home ends at the eastern gate of a walled city.

You stand with a travel pack over one shoulder and dust on your boots. Beyond the gate, wagons creak over cobbles, vendors call from the roadside, and somewhere deeper in the streets waits the Adventurer's Guild.

The guard line is moving. If you want a legal adventurer's tag before nightfall, the guild hall is the next stop.

full_character.speech_style: Concise, grounded, helpful, and genre-aware; gives useful job details without narrating hidden mechanics.

starting_known_facts: Runs a sandbox job hub suitable for fantasy, adventure stories.
Can explain available jobs, rewards, turn-ins, and local dangers.
Exists to make optional money and side-objective play available without relying on AI-invented economy actions.
